10 (a) Jess runs on 5 days each week to prepare for a race.
In week 1, every run is 2 km.
In week 2, every run is 2.5 km.
In week 3, every run is 3 km.
Jess increases the distance of the run by 0.5 km every week.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the week in which Jess runs 16 km on each of the 5 days.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the total distance Jess will have run by the end of week 8.

parts.text:
Kyle also runs on 5 days each week to prepare for a race.
In week 1, every run is 2 km.
In week 2, every run is 2.5 km.
In week 3, every run is 3.125 km.
The distances he runs each week form a geometric progression.

parts.label: (i)

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the first week in which Kyle will run more than 16 km on each of the 5 days.

parts.label: (iii)
